family_training_outputs: independent binary heads; inference uses positive softmax probability argmax over seen attacks; no router

family_training_schedule.access_scope: caller-provided current attack TRAIN plus retained old attack TRAIN only

family_training_schedule.objective: mean of new-head minibatch-class-balanced binary cross-entropies

gate_benign_teacher: previous-task G before any current-task updates; cached current benign logits

gate_training_schedule.kd_reduction: mean squared raw logits over eligible rows and both output columns
